producer_report.summary: OLY-B-A4-04 now has a recorded mechanism: setup.sh, which installs the pinned, checksum-checked rustup-init only when cargo is missing and ends in one locked exec of `cargo run -p xtask -- setup`. Its measure ends `status: not shown` and names the test command. The new test file xtask/tests/setup_one_command.rs reads the committed spec entry, setup.sh, README.md and rust-toolchain.toml. I added a CHANGELOG entry and registered the test in xtask/shard-timings.txt. Setup behavior is unchanged. I did not run cargo clippy or the full cargo test; those are left to Athena's checks.

checks_run.command: cargo test -p xtask --test setup_one_command --test spec --test policy

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml entry OLY-B-A4-04 has a mechanism that is not `none`, names setup.sh, xtask/src/main.rs and the new test file (all existing files), keeps owner = "Athena", and has a measure ending in `status: not shown` that names the test command.
criteria_check.evidence: Edited the entry in docs/spec.toml. The test the_spec_entry_has_a_mechanism_owner_and_measure checks every one of these properties and passes.

criteria_check.criterion: A new test file under xtask/tests/ (e.g. xtask/tests/setup_one_command.rs) parses docs/spec.toml and asserts OLY-B-A4-04 has a non-blank, non-`none` mechanism whose named files exist; asserts the owner; and asserts setup.sh has one locked `cargo run -p xtask -- setup` exec and a pinned, checksummed rustup-init.
criteria_check.evidence: Created xtask/tests/setup_one_command.rs with 5 tests covering these assertions. All 5 pass.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask --test setup_one_command`: it passes with the change. A test would fail if the mechanism were reverted to `none`, and the test asserts that case.
criteria_check.evidence: The run passed, 5 of 5. The spec-entry test asserts a mechanism that is not none, so it fails if the entry is reverted. reverting_the_mechanism_to_none_is_a_gap asserts none, blank and missing count as gaps. I did not revert the entry to watch the test fail.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask --test spec`: the existing check that every active requirement has a mechanism, owner and measure still passes.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran cargo test -p xtask --test spec: 30 passed.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test`: all pass, with Athena's recorded checks on the final tree counting as evidence.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran cargo fmt --all, and the policy, spec and mirrors tests passed.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md records this change in a new entry. No existing entry of docs/decisions.md or anything under records/ is edited.
criteria_check.evidence: Added a new first bullet under Unreleased/Added in CHANGELOG.md. docs/decisions.md and records/ are untouched.

learnings: The Bash hook only allows listed commands, and pipes to tail are refused.
A new xtask test file needs a line in xtask/shard-timings.txt.
